title: 2021 AMC 10B Problem 10
statement: An inverted cone with base radius \(12 \mathrm{ cm}\) and height \(18 \mathrm{ cm}\) is full of water. The water is poured into a tall cylinder whose horizontal base has a radius of \(24 \mathrm{ cm}.\) What is the height in centimeters of the water in the cylinder?

solutions.text:
The volumes must be the same since the water is poured from one to another. The volume of the cone is \(\frac{r^2h \pi}3 = \frac{12^2\cdot 18 \pi}3 = 864 \pi.\)

The volume of the cylinder is \(r^2h \pi =24^2h \pi = 576h \pi.\) This makes \(576 h \pi = 864 \pi,\) so \(h = 1.5.\)

Thus, the answer is A .
hints: Set the cone volume equal to the cylinder volume
The cylinder radius is twice the cone radius
